method.informationScope: All goal-aware bots clone complete deterministic engine state, including RNG and replacement outcomes. Greedy/Coverage see full immediate cascades; Planning sees bounded future turns. Humans cannot see these future draws. Bot scores are full-information heuristic results, not visible-board human reasoning.

policies.random: Uniform legal move; seeded tie/choice stream.
policies.greedy: Immediate normalized score deficit, layer progress and newly completed ground; no lookahead.
policies.coverage: Immediate remaining-layer gain, newly completed ground, then capped score progress.
policies.planning: Configured bounded beam search without certified-route access. Clones expose exact deterministic future refills to this bot; humans cannot see these outcomes.

method.strategicHelpProxy: Planning advantage over the strongest one-step model; this does not measure actual hint demand.
method.initialConstruction: Levels 1–8 and10 use stable samples or local mutations of original starts. Recovery level9 uses stable initial layouts with3 or4 distinct values from the unchanged5-value palette. Every subsequent refill uses the full original palette.
method.warning: Bot results describe these policies and starts, not human win rates. Ties may yield identical trajectories; uniqueTrajectories is reported. No payment or player-spend inputs exist.
